en: A monochrome (black‑and‑white) historic postcard view of a cobblestoned street lined with multi‑story traditional houses. On the right is a small square with trees and a tall stone obelisk-like monument surrounded by hedges. A person dressed in dark clothing walks up the street holding an umbrella. The caption at the top reads in German, indicating the town and the specific square.
